svg.title: Warehouse picker — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as warehouse picker, wearing a safety vest and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: Two boxed shelf levels stand beside a separate handled picking tote rather than a generic warehouse building. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
